residual_risks: The new path override trusts x-vercel-isr on every serverless invocation. Repository evidence does not establish whether Vercel strips or overwrites that header on external requests; if it does not, requests reaching _render can select a different Astro route via x_astro_path, potentially bypassing route-level edge middleware.
testing_gaps: The existing path-override security tests do not exercise an external request carrying both x-vercel-isr: 1 and x_astro_path. A deployed Vercel test would establish whether that header can reach _render from a client.
